Hints: Split the two-digit factor into tens and ones. Multiply each part, then add.
Solution: Split 38 into 30 + 8. Multiply each part: 30 x 4 = 120; 8 x 4 = 32. Add: 120 + 32 = 152. In blank order, enter 120,32,152.

Hints: For a rectangle, multiply length by width. Split a long side by place value and add the smaller areas. Use square units.
